summary.text: Stephanie Smith, a Democrat, represents District 45 (Baltimore City) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Smith was born in Virginia Beach, Virginia, on May 20, 1981.

The legislature's biography lists a B.A. in political science from Hampton University in 2003, an M.A. in urban affairs and public policy from the University of Delaware in 2006, and a J.D. from Howard University School of Law in 2009.

It lists service as an AmeriCorps VISTA member, a Congressional Black Caucus Foundation fellow, a staff attorney at Earthjustice from 2010 to 2016, and assistant director of the City of Baltimore Department of Planning (Equity, Engagement and Communications) from 2017, and says Smith is married with two children.
